name: Barbell Pause Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted firmly, grip the bar slightly outside shoulder width, and unrack it over your shoulders.
Set your shoulder blades back and down, brace your trunk, and lower the bar smoothly to your lower chest.
Bring the bar to a complete motionless pause on your chest while holding full body tension.
Press the bar explosively up and slightly back over your shoulders until your elbows lock out.
tips: Keep your upper back tight and chest lifted during the pause rather than letting the bar sink.
Drive smoothly through your feet while keeping your glutes planted firmly on the bench.
